name: Moog Inc.
summary:
Moog (MOG.A) reported earnings of $3.37 per share on revenue of $1.25 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $2.70 per share on revenue of $1.12 billion. The company beat consensus estimates by 24.81% while revenue grew 19.54% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP earnings of $13.05 to $13.55 per share on revenue of approximately $4.95 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $12.02 per share on revenue of $4.72 billion for the year ending September 30, 2027.

Moog Inc. is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and integrator of precision control components and systems.
subject: Moog Beat Consensus Estimates, Guides Above Estimates

name: BJ's Wholesale Club Holdings, Inc.
summary:
BJ's Wholesale Club (BJ) reported earnings of $1.73 per share on revenue of $6.28 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended October 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.24 per share on revenue of $5.95 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.28 per share. The company beat expectations by 35.16% while revenue grew 17.49% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it now expects fiscal year non-GAAP earnings of $5.10 to $5.30 per share. The company's previous guidance was non-GAAP earnings of $4.60 to $4.80 per share. The current consensus earnings estimate is $4.72 per share for the year ending January 31, 2027.

“We delivered a strong third quarter driven by robust traffic growth and record membership. Our 42nd birthday celebration was a resounding success. We seized a unique opportunity to invest in our stakeholders and to live our purpose of taking care of the families who depend on us. We’re excited about the momentum across our strategic priorities, and we remain committed to investing in growth for the long term,” said Bob Eddy, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, BJ’s Wholesale Club.

BJ's Wholesale Club Holdings, Inc. is a leading operator of membership warehouse clubs in the Eastern United States.
subject: BJ's Wholesale Club Beat Expectations, Raises Guidance
